🏃‍♀️ Welcome to Dr. Farokh Zavosh - Vancouver Chiropractor: Stretches, Exercises, Health, Education, and Foot Orthotics Channel. I'm going to provide you with the information, knowledge, and tools you can use to get the most out of life by becoming and staying physically healthy, enjoying your everyday life, having fun, and being able to live a healthier and more active life.

🏋 I'll show you the best exercises and stretches videos, talking about the most common health issues that I hear from my own chiropractic patients and people around me. Also, I will talk about custom foot orthotics, chiropractic, and the benefits one can get from these services.

🙌 Don't miss out on daily videos, subscribe to the channel right now and join the health nation.
